name: Read videos
plain: Lets the app read all videos in the shared gallery.
meaning: Exposes recorded and downloaded videos. Same Play restrictions as photos.

android.prompt_ui: Same Photos and videos prompt as images
android.revocation: Settings > Apps > Permissions > Photos and videos
android.store_policy: Play: Photo and Video Permissions declaration
android.note: Grouped with READ_MEDIA_IMAGES in the same dialog.

ios.prompt_ui: Photos prompt covers photos and videos
ios.note: Same grant as images on iOS.

limits.headline: Can open every video in your gallery on Android, and on iPhone with the photos permission
limits.user_action: You tap Allow on the Photos and videos prompt
can: List and open videos in your shared gallery on Android
Open videos on iPhone with the same permission as photos
Upload videos you choose for editing or backup
cannot: See only some videos when you pick Allow all; choose Select to limit it
Use a separate prompt on iPhone; one Photos permission covers both
Open private folders of other apps
Keep access after you turn it off in Settings
limits.differs: Android groups videos with photos in the same prompt on newer versions. iPhone uses one Photos permission for both.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app read every video in your shared gallery.

marketing.name: Granular media permissions
marketing.pitch: Android 13 notes: apps ask for photos, video or audio separately instead of all storage.

story.for_you: A pop up asks to access videos. Allow all means the app can see every clip, including recordings of kids, screen recordings and downloaded files.
story.for_makers: Needed by video editors and gallery apps. Google Play now restricts it to apps where full access is truly core, and asks others to use the Photo Picker.

use_cases.example: A video editor opens your clips so you can cut and mix them.
A short video app lets you pick a clip from your gallery to post.
A backup app copies new videos to the cloud.
A video player finds movies saved on your phone.
A school app lets a student upload a video assignment.
A chat app sends a clip from your gallery.
Bad apps could look through videos for private moments.

story.android_note: Needs READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, and Play restricts it like photos.
story.ios_note: iOS covers videos in its Photos permission.
